trust_decision.summary: Whether Kubernetes resources taken from a user-editable project file may be server-side-applied in Karavan's namespace: at the pinned commit KubernetesService.startDeployment applies every item with no kind, namespace or pod-spec check; the fix adds a kind allowlist, metadata.name check, host-level pod-spec rejection and a namespace pin before apply.

landing_point.why: The summary names kubernetes.yaml; its only consumer is InfrastructureResource.start (InfrastructureResource.java:94-99), which hands the text straight to startDeployment.

fix_sites.module_kind: service (Kubernetes client wrapper), validation added in startDeployment + new validateDeploymentResource/validatePodSpec/validateContainer (fix.diff:652-756)
shell build script; splits compile/push/JKube deploy, no validation (fix.diff:59-68)
shell build script; build split only, not part of the protection (fix.diff:5-34)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The only other non-Java protective change is RBAC narrowing in docs/install/karavan-kubernetes/role.yaml (fix.diff:502-578), a deployment manifest, not code a behavioural test can reach.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Devmode route: it reads a different file (deployment.jkube.yaml, not kubernetes.yaml), builds a dev-only Pod rather than applying a resource list, and replaces the user's containers with Karavan's own, so a solver can argue the fragment is 'only a template for resources/volume mounts' and outside the advisory.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate Deployment/Service/ConfigMap/Secret items in kubernetes.yaml must still apply with Karavan's labels merged into metadata and pod template; on the devmode route the fragment legitimately supplies container env, resource limits and volumeMounts (configMap/secret volumes), which an over-broad fix (drop all volumes, reject the fragment) breaks. Note the fix's application.properties key 'deployment.allowed-kinds' (fix.diff:815) does not match the @ConfigProperty name 'karavan.deployment.allowed-kinds' (fix.diff:638), so Ingress stays rejected by default.

O6_input_shapes: kind outside the allowlist (Pod, DaemonSet, ClusterRoleBinding, ...) (fix.diff:700-704)
privileged / allowPrivilegeEscalation / added capabilities in containers AND initContainers (fix.diff:731-750)
metadata.namespace pointing outside Karavan's namespace (pinned, fix.diff:683-684)

O7_producer.where: karavan-app/src/main/java/org/apache/camel/karavan/kubernetes/KubernetesService.java:251 (Serialization.unmarshal to KubernetesList); for the uncovered devmode route, KubernetesService.java:387 (Serialization.unmarshal to Deployment) feeds the PodSpec reused at :390 and :437-447

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Devmode run: project deployment.jkube.yaml is unmarshalled and its pod template PodSpec reused as the devmode Pod spec; containers are replaced but volumes (hostPath), hostNetwork/hostPID/hostIPC, initContainers, pod securityContext and the user container's volumeMounts survive, then server-side-applied with no validation.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different file name and feature (developer mode, not 'deployment start'); containers are rebuilt by Karavan so it looks already sanitised.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: Same file as the landing point but reached from DevModeResource.java:58-61 -> ProjectService.java:136-139 -> CodeService.java:143-146 -> KubernetesService.java:329-340; three packages (api, service, kubernetes).

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Project build on Kubernetes runs JKube 'k8s:resource k8s:apply' in the builder pod, which applies project-supplied JKube resource fragments with the builder service account, no kind or pod-spec check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Runs in a separate builder pod through Maven/JKube, not Karavan's Java API code; the published fix itself only restructured this script.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: Shell resource under src/main/resources/configuration/kubernetes, reached via ProjectResource.java:135-138 -> ProjectService.java:156-159.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Kind allowlist compares item.getKind() only, ignoring apiVersion/group, so a custom resource declaring kind Secret or Deployment in another group would pass (parser-identity differential).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Matching on kind name alone is the natural first implementation with fabric8's HasMetadata; a maintainer rarely thinks of group-qualified identity.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Devmode PodSpec reuse: keep volumes/initContainers from the fragment while rebuilding containers, a how-type sibling where the fix needs the partial-reuse mechanism understood.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Already present in real code; maintainers reuse the template spec so users can mount ConfigMaps/Secrets in devmode.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second 'apply environment resources' endpoint (e.g. per-env file prod.kubernetes.yaml applied by a rollout/redeploy action) calling client.resource(...).serverSideApply() directly instead of startDeployment.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: File name is already environment-prefixed here; a rollout or redeploy helper that re-applies the file is a plausible addition next to rolloutDeployment (KubernetesService.java:241-247).

O9_family: CWE-20 improper input validation: untrusted Kubernetes manifest applied with service-account privileges (privilege escalation via resource kind / pod spec)

O10_build.toolchain: Maven, Quarkus 3.33.3.1, Quinoa (npm build of src/main/webui)
services: Kubernetes API server for real behaviour (fabric8 mock server possible in tests)
O10_build.project_tests: None: karavan-app/src/test has no files at the pinned commit; quarkus-junit is declared in karavan-app/pom.xml:135.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a kind allowlist plus pod-spec checks inside startDeployment only, leaving the devmode PodSpec reuse from deployment.jkube.yaml unchecked.

out_of_scope_notes: Docker mode: project docker-compose volumes are converted into bind mounts with no host-path check (karavan-app/src/main/java/org/apache/camel/karavan/docker/DockerComposeConverter.java:94-111, DockerService.java:232-233); different sink (Docker API), not pursued.
The fix also deletes the unused execCommandInDeployment (KubernetesService.java:735), which has no callers at the pinned commit.
The fix narrows RBAC in docs/install manifests and deletes the Helm chart (fix.diff:77-578); these are deployment docs, not code.
unverified: Whether Camel JBang 'export' copies project *.jkube.yaml files into src/main/jkube so that JKube k8s:apply (build.sh:20) applies them; this decides whether O8 route 2 is real.
